current_evidence: The council's Local List page still offers the Minerals and Waste Local List and the Regulation 3 Local List and says 'On 5 June 2023 the County Council's Cabinet approved' the 2023 Local List, which 'replaces the previous version dated 2016'. No newer version is shown.

issues.detail: The List date 2023-06-01 comes from PDF metadata. Both documents give only 'June 2023' on their covers, and the council page gives Cabinet approval on 5 June 2023. The month is right, but the date should be 2023-06-05 with 'Cabinet approval' as its basis. The 'Outdated (>2y)' flag is correct on age alone, but these are still the current lists.
issues.evidence: Cover of both lists: 'June 2023'; Local List page: 'On 5 June 2023 the County Council's Cabinet approved ...'

issues.detail: Net Zero Carbon Statement is missing from all of Grokbot's data. Both lists require it for all applications: an energy statement showing how the development achieves net zero carbon, and how any shortfall will be met.
issues.evidence: Net Zero Carbon Statement: 'Required by the Climate Change Act 2008. Required for all applications.' (Reg 3 p.54, M&W p.64)

issues.detail: Dust Impact Assessment (M&W list) is missing. It is required for all mineral extraction and waste management facility development. It covers the baseline dust climate, dust-generating operations, mitigation and monitoring.
issues.evidence: Dust Impact Assessment: 'Required for all development for mineral extraction and waste management facilities.'

issues.detail: Restoration and Aftercare (M&W list) is missing as a requirement. It is required for all proposals that disturb the ground for mineral extraction or waste disposal, except S73 applications with no effect on final restoration or aftercare. Only one sentence of it, about Agricultural Land Classification, appears, under the wrong name 'Agricultural Land Classification / Soils' in Full planning.
issues.evidence: Restoration and Aftercare: 'Required for all proposals which involve the disturbance of the ground for the extraction of mineral or waste disposal except for applications seeking to vary/remove a condition which has no impact on the final restoration/aftercare'

issues.detail: Airport Safeguarding Statement is missing in both lists, and its text appears only inside the SCI trigger. It is required within the consultation areas of Norwich International Airport, RAF Marham, RAF Swanton Morley, RAF Honington, RAF Lakenheath, RAF Mildenhall and the MoD sites at Neatishead, Old Buckenham, Trimingham and Weybourne. It applies to development over 90m, structures that could reflect or diffract radio signals, lighting that could distract pilots, and bird-attracting development. The M&W list also covers mineral extraction including landfilling, waste management (landfilling, composting, recycling, treatment) and gas flaring or venting.
issues.evidence: Airport Safeguarding Statement: 'Required for all applications within the consultation area of civil and military aerodromes and airstrips (Norwich International Airport, RAF Marham ...)'

issues.detail: Public Rights of Way (PRoW) Statement is missing in both lists. It is required for proposals that divert, extinguish or create PRoWs, or that need a PRoW temporarily closed during development. It must include a drawing of all PRoWs crossing or next to the site and details of impact and mitigation.
issues.evidence: PRoW Statement: 'Required for all proposals requiring any diversions/extinguishments of existing PRoWs and the creation of new PRoWs.'

issues.detail: Landfill Statement (M&W list) is missing. It is required for any application that proposes landfilling, including re-working or reclamation of former mineral sites. It covers capacity, fill rates and waste codes, settlement, compaction and proof that the fill is the minimum needed.
issues.evidence: Landfill Statement: 'Required for any application which proposes landfilling (including re-working or reclamation of former mineral sites)'

issues.detail: Phasing plans / Proposed Scheme of Working (M&W list) is missing. It is required for all applications where operations are phased. It covers extraction/landfill limits, soil storage, screening bunds, plant locations, direction of working, haul routes, drainage, and landfill gas and leachate control.
issues.evidence: Phasing plans/Proposed Scheme of Working: 'Required for all applications where operations are proposed in a phased manner'

issues.detail: Two soils requirements in the M&W list are missing. (1) Soil Assessment is required for major development on agricultural land where significant soil is removed or a significant area of farmland is lost, with soil surveys on Grade 1, 2 or 3a land. (2) Soils Management and Handling Strategy is required where significant development of agricultural land is involved. Grokbot's 'Agricultural Land Classification / Soils' row carries restoration text, not these sections.
issues.evidence: Soil Assessment: 'Required for applications which involve major development on agricultural land ...'; Soils Management and Handling Strategy: 'Required for applications where significant development of agricultural land is involved'

issues.detail: Bio-aerosol Assessment (M&W list) is missing. It is required for new waste composting facilities, or changes to existing ones, within 250m of the boundary of a sensitive receptor.
issues.evidence: Bio-aerosol Assessment: 'Required for applications for new waste composting facilities or changes to existing facilities within 250m of the boundary of a sensitive receptor'

issues.detail: Borehole or trial pit analysis (M&W list) is missing. It is required for applications involving mineral extraction and restoration and must give soil depths, mineral content and the winter water table position.
issues.evidence: Borehole or trial pit analysis: 'For applications involving mineral extraction and restoration'

issues.detail: External Materials Sample Board (Reg 3 list) is missing. It is required for all applications where new built development is proposed, with details or samples of external materials, hard landscaping and boundary treatments.
issues.evidence: External Materials Sample Board: 'Required for all applications where new built development is proposed'

issues.detail: The Reg 3 list's Educational Need Statement is missing. It forms part of the Planning Statement where educational development is proposed and covers school benefits, the Local Growth Investment Plan, alternatives, pupil and staff numbers, and class sizes.
issues.evidence: Planning Statement (Reg 3): 'where educational development is proposed an educational need statement should be provided (if relevant)'

issues.detail: Three smaller submission requirements are missing. (1) Reg 3 applications that need planning obligations must submit a Unilateral Undertaking at application stage. (2) For M&W waste schemes, the list asks for a statement on the stage reached with the Environment Agency over an Environmental Permit or exemption, and for the permit application reference where one has been made. (3) Both lists say that if a checklist item is omitted, the applicant should give a written justification, using the Local List Checklist's 'Justification for omission' column.
issues.evidence: 'Any obligations would be required through the submission of a Unilateral Undertaking at application stage'; 'Where an application for an Environmental Permit has already been made the reference of the application should be provided'

issues.detail: The Regulation 3 list is a separate document, 'National and Local Validation Requirements for County Council (Regulation 3) Planning Applications'. Its 39 local requirements belong under 'County own devt (Reg 3)', but that row says '(none)'. The 20 Reg 3-sourced rows Grokbot extracted are filed under 'Full planning' instead, for example Construction Management Plan, Land Contamination, Daylight/Sunlight, Archaeology, Flood Risk Assessment, Parking Provision and Travel Plan. Air Quality Impact Assessment also appears in the Reg 3 list but Grokbot has it only under Minerals & waste.
issues.evidence: 'County own devt (Reg 3)' = '(none)'; Reg 3 list p.2: 'guidance on the information required by Norfolk County Council to support planning applications submitted under Regulation 3'

issues.detail: The 'Minerals & waste (county)' sheet holds only 20 rows. Many M&W list requirements were sourced from the M&W PDF but filed only under 'Full planning'. They include: site/block plan, elevations, floor plans, sections, roof plans, photographs, Planning Statement, Economic Statement, Biodiversity Surveys, BNG, EIA, Lighting Scheme, Mineral Resource Assessment, Nutrient Neutrality, SuDS, Sequential/Exception Test and Tree Survey/AIA. Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment is in the M&W list but has no M&W row at all.
issues.evidence: e.g. Full planning | Biodiversity Net Gain (source 19minerals-and-waste-local-list.pdf); no 'Minerals & waste (county)' row for BNG, SuDS, LVIA or Lighting

issues.detail: 40 of the 43 'Full planning' rows are marked 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. Norfolk County Council determines only minerals/waste (county matter) and Regulation 3 applications. Mapping its lists onto district application types such as Full planning gives a misleading picture, and the sheet mixes rows from both lists.
issues.evidence: Both lists p.2: 'Planning applications for residential and commercial development are dealt with by the relevant District/Borough/City Council'

issues.detail: The 'Variation of condition s73' and 'Non-material amendment' rows say '(none)', but both lists set minimum requirements for them. For S73 and S73A these are: application form, fee, a location plan with the same red line as the original permission (otherwise invalid), a covering letter, site plan, floor plans, elevations and roof plan where appropriate, a Planning Statement explaining the changes, and updated supporting documents. S96A non-material amendments need the same core set. Grokbot captured these sections only as cut-off fragments in 'Drawing / document standards'.
issues.evidence: Section 73 applications: 'As a minimum requirement, the County Council requires the following ... The red line should be exactly the same as that which was approved under the original grant of permission'

issues.detail: Several rows are filed under application types that neither list assigns. Flood Risk Assessment sits under 'Change of use - prior approval' because the FRA trigger mentions 'change of use', but that refers to planning applications, and the county does not handle prior approvals. Health Impact Assessment and Heritage Statement sit under 'Listed building consent', although neither list ties them to LBC. 'Reserved matters | Highways / access details' is site location plan and Certificates text, and the Certificates section actually exempts Reserved Matters.
issues.evidence: FRA: 'In Flood Zone 2 or 3 including minor development and change of use'; Certificates: 'for all applications except: Approval of Reserved Matters'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts come from a neighbouring section, not the requirement itself. SCI (Reg 3) carries the Airport Safeguarding text, and SCI (M&W) carries the Agricultural Justification text. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Lighting Assessment' both carry the M&W Airport Safeguarding bullet list, not the SuDS trigger (major development: 1,000m2 or 1ha) or the Lighting trigger (new external lighting). Health Impact Assessment (LBC and M&W) carries the Heritage Statement text. 'Ventilation / Extraction (odour)' carries EIA text in Full planning and Open Space text in M&W. 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' carries the pre-application/submission paragraph. 'Habitats Regulations Assessment' carries the BNG heading.
issues.evidence: SCI trigger: '...Statement of Community Involvement, (as amended) 26 Airport Safeguarding Statement Required by...'; M&W odour trigger: '...Updated November 2022 67 Open Space Assessment Required by...'

issues.detail: Several triggers drop the thresholds or conditions the lists set. Reg 3 Transport Assessment gives only 'Required by ... local plan policies' and omits 30+ two-way vehicle movements an hour, 100+ a day, 100+ parking spaces, D1 over 1,000sqm (Transport Statement for 500-1,000sqm), and so on. M&W Travel Plan omits 'non-residential development proposals with 50 or more employees'. M&W Energy Statement omits 'all applications for major development'. Economic Statement omits its mineral and waste triggers. Biodiversity is reduced to 'sites or protected species.' The DAS trigger is cut off before the M&W exemptions for waste development, engineering or mining operations and S73. The Reg 3 Nutrient Neutrality trigger, which covers overnight accommodation, is replaced by the M&W wording.
issues.evidence: Reg 3 TA: 'Generating 30 or more two-way vehicle movements in any hour'; M&W Travel Plan: 'Required for all non-residential development proposals with 50 or more employees'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts start with page-number or footer fragments such as 'policies 38', 'website 29', 'Norfolk 48' or 'H 44', and many are cut off mid-sentence before the actual trigger (M&W Flood Risk, Foul Sewage, Archaeology, Air Quality and Heritage Statement). The 'Block plan / Site plan' trigger is just a contents-page dotted line. The real trigger is 'for all applications except Outline applications'.
issues.evidence: Block plan / Site plan trigger: 'Proposed Site/Block Plan ......'

issues.detail: Several Grokbot rows name requirements that appear in neither list. Generic template names were attached to text from other sections. 'Coal Mining / Land Stability Risk Assessment' (M&W) is the Planning Statement's mineral/waste content list. 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' is the Economic Statement for major waste proposals. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is the Lighting Scheme trigger. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is the Structural Survey. 'Habitats Regulations Assessment / SPA mitigation' is Biodiversity references plus the BNG heading. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is advisory text. 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space' is the tail of the Daylight/Sunlight trigger.
issues.evidence: Coal Mining trigger: '...Waste Development: A full description of the scope of the proposed development including: - processes to be undertaken on site'

issues.detail: The 'Submission rules' and 'Drawing / document standards' tab items (23 rows) are mostly process and formatting guidance, not local requirements. The lists call them 'recommended' standards. Examples: the 10MB firewall limit, USB submission, paper copy numbers, PDF layer settings, file-naming best practice, pre-application advice, and the S73A/S96A/'Significant Changes' explanatory text. Several are also cut off mid-sentence.
issues.evidence: 'The following standards for on-line submissions are recommended ... Firewall restrictions limit the maximum size of individual attachments to 10MB'

issues.detail: Grokbot's tab_items hold no local requirements. All 27 rows are submission guidance, drawing standards, protected-site definitions or contents-page fragments. None of the 39 Reg 3 or 46 M&W local requirement sections (e.g. Planning Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Landscape Scheme) was captured verbatim. They appear only as template names in app_type_rows.
issues.evidence: Local Requirements contents (Reg 3 p.15-16, M&W p.17-19) vs tab_items sections 'Drawing / document standards', 'Submission rules', 'Policy-driven requirements'

issues.detail: Several real requirements are filed under the wrong name. Agricultural Justification Statement (agricultural reservoirs) appears as 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal'. Hydrology/Hydrogeology Assessment appears as 'Ground investigation / Geotechnical / Basement Impact Assessment' in M&W, and the Reg 3 row of that name is a SuDS sub-list. Mineral Resource Assessment appears as 'Minerals / Waste specific statements (county matters)'. Restoration and Aftercare's ALC sentence appears as 'Agricultural Land Classification / Soils'. Biodiversity Surveys and Assessments appears as 'Ecological Survey / Assessment'.
issues.evidence: M&W row 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal': '28 Agricultural Justification Statement ... Required for applications for agricultural reservoirs'

issues.detail: The same drawing-standards and S73A/S96A text appears twice in tab_items, once from each list. The policy rows repeat the protected-sites definition, and a contents-page entry ('Page 65 Nutrient Neutrality Statement / Assessment .....') is captured as a policy requirement. In app_type_rows, 'Sunlight to gardens' duplicates Daylight/Sunlight, and the HIA and Heritage Statement rows under LBC and M&W carry identical Heritage Statement text.
issues.evidence: 'All drawings should include a scale bar, north point...' captured from both PDFs

issues.detail: Grokbot also read 'Local list Minerals and Waste comparison v3.pdf' from the eplanning system. This is a consultation comparison of changes, not the adopted list. Two tab items come from it ('A new section is added titled Nutrient Neutrality.' and a summary of the introduction section), and they are commentary, not requirements.
issues.evidence: Tab item: 'A new section is added titled Nutrient Neutrality.' (source ...Local%20list%20Minerals%20and%20Waste%20comparison%20v3.pdf)

issues.detail: The reference row links only the Minerals and Waste Local List. The Regulation 3 Local List is a separate, equally current June 2023 document and the source of about half the rows, so it should be recorded as a second validation list URL.
issues.evidence: M&W list p.2: 'Please see other guidance note for Regulation 3 applications.'

summary: Grokbot links to the current Norfolk lists (Minerals & Waste and Regulation 3, June 2023), but its extraction is poor: the tab items hold only submission and drawing guidance, and 13 local requirements are missing outright, including Net Zero Carbon Statement, Airport Safeguarding, PRoW Statement, Dust Impact Assessment, Restoration and Aftercare, Landfill Statement, Phasing plans and the soils assessments. The requirements it did capture are spread across district application types, with the Reg 3 sheet left empty and the S73/NMA sheets wrongly marked '(none)'. Many triggers come from neighbouring sections, and several requirement names, such as Coal Mining Risk Assessment, appear in neither list.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
